name: get_tool_history
description: Alarms and repairs on one tool in the given number of days before the current alarm, oldest first. The alarm record's recent_history already lists this tool's last 7 days; use this to look further back or at another tool.

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 90

name: get_alarm_code_history
description: Every tool that reported this alarm code in the given number of days before the current alarm, oldest first. Use it to see whether the same problem shows up on other tools.

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 90

name: search_sops
description: Every SOP that lists this alarm code, with its steps. For background only: the plan cites only the SOPs given in the user message.
